2609.02191.title: Examining the Vulnerability of Multi-Agent Medical Systems to Human Interventions for Clinical Reasoning
2609.02191.paper_summary: Human interventions at fault points can alter the diagnostic accuracy of multi-agent medical systems. We defined fault points as moments in AI agent conversations, in which an agent's reasoning became most vulnerable to external influence. Using the MedQA dataset, this study analyzed simulated doctor-patient conversations to measure how interventions shifted reasoning and accuracy. Correct intervention methods showed an improvement in baseline diagnostic accuracy of up to 40%, while incorrect or bias-related interventions degraded performance by up to 6% and increased diagnostic drift and uncertainty. Beyond performance changes, our analysis revealed behavioral similarities between cognitive biases in simulated agent environments and real-world clinical practice. Examples included premature closure and susceptibility to misleading cues. Overall, these findings demonstrate that identifying and guiding fault points with human interventions may provide a mechanism for improving diagnostic robustness in multi-agent medical systems.
2609.02191.paper_summary_zh: 人類在故障點的介入可以改變多代理醫療系統的診斷準確性。<lb/>我們將故障點定義為AI代理對話中的時刻，在這些時刻，代理的推理最容易受到外部影響。<lb/>本研究使用MedQA數據集分析模擬的醫生-病人對話，以測量介入如何改變推理和準確性。<lb/>正確的介入方法顯示出基線診斷準確性提高了多達40%，而不正確或與偏見相關的介入則使性能下降了多達6%，並增加了診斷漂移和不確定性。<lb/>除了性能變化，我們的分析還揭示了模擬代理環境中的認知偏見與現實世界臨床實踐之間的行為相似性。<lb/>例子包括過早關閉和對誤導性線索的易感性。<lb/>總體而言，這些發現表明，通過人類介入識別和引導故障點可能提供改善多代理醫療系統診斷穩健性的一種機制。
